mechanism: Glyburide may impair vitamin B12 absorption by affecting calcium-dependent intrinsic factor binding in the terminal ileum, while cyanocobalamin supplementation may help correct B12 deficiency that can worsen glycemic control.
action: Monitor vitamin B12 levels in patients on chronic glyburide therapy; supplementation with cyanocobalamin is appropriate and often necessary but should not replace evaluation for underlying B12 deficiency etiology.
